system.description:
Mark a Stress to deploy a Device.

A Device is deployed into the scene and remains until destroyed, recalled, or the scene ends. Devices have a range upon which you can control them. You can only have 1 device deployed at any given time.

Unless otherwise specified, devices cannot move, act or attack by thelselves, are destroyed if they take two hits, have an evasion of 9.

Recon Drone

The recon drone flies and is equiped with a camera. It can move up to Far range.
Control: up to Far range.
Activate (Spellcast Roll (10)): reports back the position of all adversaries and important objects within Close range of the drone, that it can see.

Repair Drone

The repair drone is filled with medical and technical supplies. It can heal a creature or repair equipment. It can move up to Close range.
Control: up to Close range.
Activate (Spellcast Roll (14)): Target a creature within melee range. On a success, clear 2 Hit Points or 2 Stress on the target. On a failure, clear a Hit Point or a Stress on the target. The device is then destroyed. You can't heal the same target with a Repair Drone again until your next long rest.

Barrier Projector

Creates temporary energy field acting as cover from ranged attacks. It cannot move.
Control: up to Very Close range.
Activate (Spellcast Roll (10)): activate the energy field that has an Evasion of 8 and can sustain 3 hits from ranged attacks.

Spend 3 Hope to deploy a Target Dummy Drone that has an Evasion of 9 and one HP. Whenever this drone is destroyed and if you are within Close range of it, you can clear 2 Stress.

This does not count towards the device limit of @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.cmQ1erqGqemNvB7U]{Field Devices}.
You have advantage on repairing or tinkering tech devices or equipment.

Engineers don't cast spells or rely on brute force. They reshape the battlefield through invention, deploying advanced technology, autonomous devices, and experimental prototypes that can turn the tide of any encounter.
Gain an additional Stress slot at character creation.

effects.name: High Stamina
effects.description: Gain an additional Stress slot at character creation.

system.description: When you fail a roll that utilized one of your Experiences, you can mark a Stress to reroll.
You have Advantage on rolls to repair machinery, fabricate equipment, or understand how technological devices function.

When you make an Attack with Hope while flying, even if it fails, you may deploy or activate a @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.cmQ1erqGqemNvB7U]{Field Device} without making the associated Spellcast Roll.

You gain a permanent jetpack. You can fly. While flying you can do the following:

  • You may deploy @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.cmQ1erqGqemNvB7U]{Field Devices} while flying.

  • Mark a Stress to gain +2 bonus to your Evasion until your next Spotlight.

  • Spend a Hope to deal an extra 1d8 damage on a successful attack.

effects.name: Attack from above
effects.description: Gain advantage and add a damage die to an attack while flying.

system.description: When you help an ally while flying, they may reroll their advantage die and keep the best result. If they deal damage through their action, they also deal 1d10 additional damage.

Humans are most easily recognized by their dexterous hands, rounded ears, and bodies built for endurance. Their average height ranges from just under 5 feet to about 6 ½ feet. They have a wide variety of builds, with some being quite broad, others lithe, and many inhabiting the spectrum in between. Humans are physically adaptable and adjust to harsh climates with relative ease. In general, humans live to an age of about 100, with their bodies changing dramatically between their youngest and oldest years.

Being part of a forgeborne community means you were raised in massive industrial complexes, orbital foundries, or bustling shipyards where construction and repair never truly stop. Your people solve problems with ingenuity, tools, and perseverance rather than brute force.

Forgeborne are often diligent, inventive, patient, resourceful, steadfast, and meticulous.

Spend a Hope to activate the Tactical Scan and select one of these modes:

  • Broadcast mode

  • Targeted mode

Broadcast mode.

Detect signs of life and movement within a Far range around you. You know the general direction, general distance and approximate size of the life forms.

Targeted mode.

You specifically configure the Tactical Scan to gather information about a life form within Close range that you know about. You can ask one information about the target such as its Difficulty, Damage Thresholds, Type, Size, total HP, Resistances or Immunities. The GM may also provide one more information.

Mark a Stress to boost the equipment of an ally within Close range or your own equipment. Apply one of these effects to your target:

  • Add 1d6 damage to the next successful attack made by the target with a primary weapon.

  • Grant +2 Evasion to the target until they are hit by an attack.
Play the Aeronaut to strategically fly around the battlefield and take or give advantage to strikes from above.
Common compact sidearm firing low-energy laser pulses. Accurate and reliable.
